subject: statistics: remove invalid histogram items in loadNeededColumnHistograms and loadNeededIndexHistograms (#60318)
summary: The commit makes async histogram loading resilient to concurrent DDL (table/column/index drop) by deleting stale entries from `asyncload.AsyncLoadHistogramNeededItems` on early-exit paths in `loadNeededColumnHistograms`/`loadNeededIndexHistograms`, and by no longer returning a NotFound error when an index has been dropped (preventing `LoadNeededHistograms` from failing the whole batch). It also adds realtikv regression tests to ensure needed-items are cleaned up after drop operations and wires them into Bazel as a `go_test` target.
